title: Storefront Rendering & BFF
body: Architecture of Storefront Web (APP-001): server-side and edge rendering with Next.js/React and a Node backend-for-frontend that aggregates catalog (APP-005), search (APP-006), cart (APP-004) and pricing (APP-007) through the API gateway (APP-024). Covers per-region rendering, ISR/edge caching and the latency profile exercised during INC-2026-016.

title: Customer Portal & Self-Service Returns (My Meridian)
body: Architecture of the My Meridian customer portal (APP-021): React plus Node BFF exposing account, order (APP-009), identity (APP-014) and loyalty (APP-015) self-service. Documents the returns-eligibility model shipped in REL-2026-008 and the fix path for the eligibility defect in INC-2026-015.

title: Checkout Orchestration
body: Architecture of the Checkout Service (APP-003): Java/Spring Boot orchestration across cart (APP-004), pricing (APP-007), payments (APP-012), inventory (APP-010) and order management (APP-009). Codifies the payment-authorization-before-inventory-commitment invariant, idempotent order placement, and guest checkout (CHK-1421), informed by INC-2026-002 and INC-2026-019.

title: Cart State & Redis Resilience
body: Architecture of the Cart Service (APP-004): Go service backed by a Redis cluster for cart state, with pricing preview (APP-007), promotion preview (APP-008) and catalog lookups (APP-005). Documents Redis primary failover, replica reads and degraded-mode behavior hardened after INC-2026-001 and shipped in REL-2026-001.

title: Product Catalog & Indexing
body: Architecture of the Product Catalog (APP-005): Java plus PostgreSQL system of record for product and offer data, projected into OpenSearch and fed by Kafka ingestion from the data platform (APP-020). Publishes catalog-change events consumed by Search (APP-006); resilience shaped by INC-2026-021 and INC-2026-003, delivered in REL-2026-002.

title: Search Hybrid Ranking
body: Architecture of Search & Browse (APP-006): Python and OpenSearch hybrid lexical-plus-vector ranking, with a reindex pipeline consuming catalog events (APP-005) and features from the data platform (APP-020). Documents price-freshness guarantees and the reindex-lag mitigations following INC-2026-003, shipped in REL-2026-002.

title: Pricing Resolution
body: Architecture of the Pricing Service (APP-007): Java plus PostgreSQL base-price and regional-rule resolution across NA, LATAM, EU and APAC with currency handling, fed by the data platform (APP-020) and consumed by cart, checkout, storefront and search. Regional rule safeguards were reinforced after INC-2026-004 and INC-2026-003, delivered in REL-2026-003.

title: Promotions Engine & Cache
body: Architecture of the Promotions Engine (APP-008): Kotlin/Spring Boot plus Redis evaluating offers, coupons and cart-level discounts, dependent on pricing (APP-007) and loyalty (APP-015) and consumed by cart (APP-004). Covers the promotion cache holistically and links to the write-through redesign (KN-228); shaped by the INC-2026-007/011/018 staleness series and REL-2026-004.

title: Order Management Saga
body: Architecture of Order Management (APP-009): Java/Spring Boot plus PostgreSQL orchestration saga across inventory (APP-010), warehouse (APP-011) and payments (APP-012) over Kafka, with compensating transactions and an explicit order-lifecycle state machine. Multi-warehouse correctness was hardened after INC-2026-012 and delivered in REL-2026-006.

title: Inventory Available-to-Promise (ATP)
body: Architecture of the Inventory Service (APP-010): Go plus PostgreSQL and Redis computing real-time available-to-promise across multiple warehouses (APP-011), with reservation semantics and Kafka event flow. Documents the oversell-prevention model introduced after INC-2026-012 and shipped in REL-2026-006.

title: Payments & PCI Boundary
body: Architecture of the Payments Service (APP-012): Java/Spring Boot plus PostgreSQL within a PCI-DSS cardholder-data boundary, covering tokenization, external PSP integration with failover, 3-D Secure and authorization/capture. Called by checkout (APP-003) through the gateway (APP-024); PSP-degradation resilience was hardened after INC-2026-009 and shipped in REL-2026-005.

title: API Gateway & Edge
body: Architecture of the API Gateway / Edge (APP-024): Envoy/Kong with Go and Lua handling ingress, routing, OIDC token verification against identity (APP-014), rate limiting and the REST/GraphQL edge for storefront, mobile and search. Edge auth and rate-limit behavior were tuned after INC-2026-013 and INC-2026-014 and shipped in REL-2026-007.

title: Event Backbone (Apache Kafka)
body: Cross-cutting architecture of MCG's Kafka event backbone: CloudEvents envelope, topic naming (for example commerce.checkout.order-placed.v1), partitioning, consumer groups, delivery semantics and dead-letter handling. Describes the producer/consumer topology spanning catalog, search, promotions, order management and inventory in line with the event-driven and open-standards principles.

title: API Contracts & Schema Registry
body: Cross-cutting architecture of API-first contracts at MCG: OpenAPI, protobuf and GraphQL SDL governed in mcg-contracts, plus the Kafka schema registry and backward-compatible expand-contract evolution (ADR-0033). Documents consumer-driven contract testing owned by Quality Engineering (TEAM-050) and the open-standards posture (ADR-0026).

title: Service Mesh & mTLS
body: Cross-cutting architecture of MCG's Kubernetes service mesh: mutual TLS on all service-to-service calls, SPIFFE-style workload identity, least-privilege traffic policy and mesh-level retries and timeouts. Realizes the security-by-design and cloud-native principles across the commerce path.

title: Feature Flags & Progressive Delivery
body: Cross-cutting architecture of the mcg-feature-flags service and MCG's progressive-delivery model: flag evaluation, canary-to-percentage-to-full rollout, automated rollback on SLO breach and kill-switches. Anchors the trunk-based development standard (ADR-0031) and the guest-checkout rollout (CHK-1421).

title: Observability & SLOs
body: Cross-cutting architecture of MCG observability: OpenTelemetry metrics, logs and traces, golden-signal SLOs and error-budget policy, alerting and incident tooling owned by SRE (TEAM-032). Defines per-tier SLO targets and the dashboards used during peak readiness (REL-2026-009) and incidents such as INC-2026-016.

title: CI/CD Golden Paths
body: Cross-cutting architecture of the DevEx (TEAM-031) golden-path pipeline: lint, build, unit, SAST/SCA, package, staging deploy, integration and contract tests, DAST, canary and progressive rollout, with signed images and SBOM provenance. Documents the per-language pipeline variants and GitOps delivery under trunk-based development (ADR-0031).

title: Data Platform Integration
body: Architecture of Enterprise Data Platform integration (APP-020): Databricks/Spark lakehouse, Snowflake marts and dbt, ingesting change and event data from the commerce services over Kafka under explicit data contracts. Feeds catalog (APP-005), pricing (APP-007) and search (APP-006) features; ingestion resilience shaped by INC-2026-021 with sensitivity classification per ADR-0043.

title: Multi-Region Topology
body: Cross-cutting architecture of MCG's multi-region topology: AWS regions mapped to the NA, LATAM, EU and APAC region codes, data-residency constraints, active-active versus active-passive posture per criticality tier, cross-region replication and latency-based routing at the edge (APP-024). Notes the Azure footprint retained for the legacy POS estate.

title: Idempotency Patterns
body: Cross-cutting architecture of idempotency at MCG: idempotency keys on order placement and payment, Redis/PostgreSQL dedup stores, at-least-once event consumers and exactly-once effects. Applied across checkout (APP-003), payments (APP-012) and order management (APP-009) per ADR-0045 and informed by INC-2026-002.

title: Caching Strategy
body: Cross-cutting architecture of MCG's layered caching: edge/CDN caching for storefront (APP-001) and Redis caches for cart (APP-004), promotions (APP-008) and inventory (APP-010), spanning read-through, write-through and cache-aside patterns with TTLs, invalidation and stampede protection. Draws on the promo-staleness lesson from INC-2026-007 and links to the write-through redesign (KN-228).

title: Resilience & Circuit Breaking
body: Cross-cutting architecture of resilience across the checkout path: timeouts, retries with jitter, circuit breakers, bulkheads, fallbacks and graceful degradation. Synthesizes lessons from INC-2026-009 (PSP degradation), INC-2026-001 (Redis failover) and INC-2026-019 (latency regression) into reusable patterns.

title: Authentication & Authorization (OIDC)
body: Architecture of Identity & Customer Profile (APP-014): Go OIDC/OAuth2 identity service issuing and verifying tokens at the edge (APP-024), distinguishing guest and registered sessions and enforcing service-to-service authorization. Documents PII handling and the token-verification fix following INC-2026-014, shipped in REL-2026-007.

title: Rate Limiting & Traffic Shaping
body: Architecture of rate limiting at the API Gateway / Edge (APP-024): token-bucket and sliding-window algorithms at Envoy/Kong, per-client and per-route quotas backed by distributed Redis counters, tiered limits and standardized 429/Retry-After handling. Thresholds were retuned after INC-2026-013 and shipped in REL-2026-007.

title: Secrets Management
body: Cross-cutting architecture of secrets management owned by Security Engineering (TEAM-040): the platform secret manager, dynamic secrets, rotation, workload identity and the prohibition on secrets in code, config or logs. Details PCI key handling for payments (APP-012) in line with security-by-design and ADR-0043.

title: Disaster Recovery
body: Cross-cutting architecture of disaster recovery at MCG: RPO/RTO targets per criticality tier, backup and restore, cross-region failover, backward-compatible expand-contract migrations and regular DR drills with runbooks. Builds on the multi-region topology (KN-219) and is owned by SRE (TEAM-032).

title: Peak-Readiness & Load Shedding
body: Cross-cutting architecture of peak readiness at MCG: capacity planning for peak and flash-sale events, autoscaling, load shedding with priority queues, graceful degradation and game days. Synthesizes lessons from INC-2026-011 and INC-2026-016 and underpins REL-2026-009.

title: Promotion-Cache Write-Through Design
body: Architecture of the systemic fix for promotion-cache staleness in the Promotions Engine (APP-008): a write-through cache with event-driven invalidation on price and promotion changes, versioned cache keys and coherence with pricing (APP-007). Directly resolves the INC-2026-007/011/018 series and was delivered in REL-2026-010.

title: Checkout Latency Budget
body: Architecture of the end-to-end checkout latency budget for the Checkout Service (APP-003): decomposition of the p99 budget across cart, pricing, promotion, inventory and payment calls, with parallelization, asynchronous promotion evaluation, per-hop timeouts and budget enforcement. Addresses the synchronous-promo regression in INC-2026-019 and was delivered in REL-2026-010.
